channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Weakened satisfaction likely to drive excessive drinking
item.description: KYOTO -- A weakening of a mechanism that produces a sense of satisfaction after drinking could lead to excessive alcohol consumption, a team of Japanese and other researchers has found.

item.title: Japan, Britain, Italy vow cooperation on fighter jet
item.description: TOKYO -- Japanese Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi held talks separately with his counterparts from Britain and Italy in Munich, southern Germany, on Friday, confirming cooperation toward joint development of a next-generation fighter jet.

item.title: Vietnam sends 250 tonnes of rice to support Cuba's food security
item.description: Vietnam has delivered 250 metric tons of rice to Cuba as part of a bilateral agreement aimed at strengthening food security and agricultural cooperation between the two nations.

item.title: 14 arrested in $97mn Cambodia-based online scam targeting Vietnamese victims
item.description: Police in Dong Nai Province, southern Vietnam have arrested 14 Vietnamese suspects involved in a Cambodia-based, Vietnamese-led online fraud ring accused of cheating thousands of victims across Vietnam out of nearly US$97 million.

item.title: Dutch-German expat sees Vietnam’s Tet as favorite time of year
item.description: Having lived in Vietnam for over five years, I consider the Lunar New Year holiday, or Tet, one of my favorite times of the year. Streets, shops, and homes are decorated in red and other festive colors.

item.title: International students in Vietnam: From classrooms to second home
item.description: International students often arrive in Vietnam intending to stay only for the duration of their studies. Yet for some, affection with the people and the land has transformed the country into a second home.

item.title: The image of horse in the lives of Vietnamese people
item.description: Horses have long been a familiar part of Vietnamese culture, accompanying people from daily life and farming to the battlefield, and often appearing alongside images of generals, deities, honor, and scholarly achievement.

item.title: Vietnam rescuers, doctors brave rough seas to save German from luxury cruise ship
item.description: The Vietnam Maritime Search and Rescue Coordination Center on Saturday afternoon confirmed that its vessel SAR274 had successfully transported a stricken German passenger aboard a luxury cruise ship to land for urgent treatment.

item.title: Thailand, Japan expand footprint in Vietnam’s consumer M&A market
item.description: Thailand and Japan emerged as the leading sources of foreign capital in Vietnam’s mergers and acquisitions (M&A) market in 2025, with investors from the two countries particularly active in consumer-focused deals.
